name: Master of Parkour 2016
description: This paint is the prize for the "Masters of Parkour" contest that took place in 2016.
interestingFacts: The paint appeared on sale only at the time of the 2016 "Masters of Parkour" competition. It was available for 1000 crystals and for players with the rank of  Warrant Officer 1 and above. After the competition, the paint was removed from all garages except those of the winners.
Starting from the 2015 competition, the Masters of Parkour paint remains in the garages of the winners forever, and a new paint will be released for new competitions.

Garage description
This paint is the prize for the "Masters of Parkour" contest that took place in 2016.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
The paint appeared on sale only at the time of the 2016 "Masters of Parkour" competition. It was available for 1000 crystals and for players with the rank of  Warrant Officer 1 and above. After the competition, the paint was removed from all garages except those of the winners.
Starting from the 2015 competition, the Masters of Parkour paint remains in the garages of the winners forever, and a new paint will be released for new competitions.
